claim: All eight factions have a readable core-formation identity while Mobs, Hexbows, Brooms, and Lanterns retain distinct grouped role silhouettes.

matched_setup.map: Rooftops at the End of Tuesday

expected_visible_change: Each faction should keep the four role geometries but replace the generic army treatment with its own standard shape, emblem, palette, headgear, and motif.
typed_observation: Eight same-map armies rendered eight distinguishable standard/headgear languages. Every accepted state included the three starting core squads, the faction signature, one completed Lantern formation, and a five-squad selection receipt. Mobs formed wedges, Hexbows ranks, Brooms diamonds, and Lanterns compact walls. No warning or error was recorded by the browser.
